messages:
aditya: @nex_anna quick sync — we need additional GPU capacity for EU Dedicated pool. Target ship window: by 2025-05-15. Options we're considering: 300 units (full commit) vs 150 units (smaller commit). Also we have ~40 failed H/W flagged for RMA at FRA warehouse — can we consolidate replacements into the same shipment to cut customs and broker fees? low-latency constraint for eu-west.

nex_anna: hi @aditya — thanks. rough lead times: 300 units => 12–14 weeks; 150 units => 8–10 weeks. Tiered pricing we can offer: 300 commit => $38,250/unit (5% off list $40k). 150 commit => $39,200/unit (2% off). We can do commit+burst (reserve 200 + 100 as burst) — pricing = commit 200 @ $39,000 + burst 100 @ $42,000 if available at ship time.
We can consolidate RMAs into the same AWB up to 50 units, but need full serial list and RMA authorization before scheduling. Consolidation saves on broker fees (~$300–$450/awb) and reduces customs entries.

marta: @nex_anna thanks. payment/PO question — what are invoice terms for a commit? we prefer Net30. also any SKU parity guarantee for Dedicated clients (can't accept refurbished unless certified)?

nex_anna: @marta Net30 is fine for commits > $1M. For Dedicated enterprise customers we guarantee factory-new parity by default. Refurb only by exception and must pass our 6-point QA — if you accept refurbished replacements for RMAs we can fast-track within 2 weeks and reduce cost by ~10% on RMA freight. Otherwise replacements are new and follow normal lead time.

liam: heads-up — our Dedicated SLOs require 99.9% available capacity for scheduled customers. If we take refurbished RMA swaps, we need a 48h soak + serial reconciliation before we route production traffic. Can vendor pre-stage units in EU to avoid long KV-cache warmups? (we want them imaged + power-tested)

nex_anna: yes we can pre-stage and do burn-in (+basic imaging). additional staging fee applies ($150/unit) or we can include staging for commits >200 at no charge. Imaging specs? send an AMI/container list and we’ll coordinate.

rma_manager: for the 40 failed units in FRA — we want a single consolidated RMA AWB to minimize broker fees. we will provide CSV with serial, failure code, depot id. can vendor confirm they will handle customs docs and absorb broker fee up to $350/awb for warranty replacements? also need ETA for replacements only (not full commit) — our cutover depends on those arriving by 2025-04-30.

nex_anna: we can absorb broker fees up to $350/awb for warranty replacements if you consolidate and sign RMA manifest within 3 business days. Replacements-only ETA (air expedited): 10–12 business days from manifest acceptance + customs clearance. If you need them by 2025-04-30 we'll need manifest signed by 2025-04-10 latest.

vendor_ops_bot: SupplyChainBot: PO draft 8675309 acknowledged by vendor (ETA window 2025-05-15 to 2025-05-29). Tracker link: https://tracking.vendor.example/8675309

aditya: ok — two asks for vendor: 1) confirm commit+burst pricing in writing and send updated offer sheet 2) confirm they will accept consolidated RMA manifest and cover up to $350/awb. we'll prepare PO after that. also can vendor supply sample CSV header for RMA serial list?

nex_anna: will send formal quote & offer sheet today. sample CSV header below:
```
serial_number, sku, failure_code, depot_id, date_failed, customer_poc, rma_id_optional
```
include rma_id if you have pre-auths. Send to rma@vendor.example and cc me.

marta: noted — we'll draft PO for commit 200 + burst 100 to match the commit+burst model while we confirm final numbers. Net30 on commits > $1M is acceptable.

liam: operational checklist before ship:
- vendor staging + power-test (requests imaging list)
- manifest + serial reconciliation
- consolidated AWB for FRA RMAs
- customs HS code: 8471.80.00 (confirm?)
if any of these block, flag earliest.

nex_anna: HS code confirmed as 8471.80.00 — customs paperwork we provide but need importer of record details. we'll send the staging checklist and imaging endpoint. planning to send quote + RMA manifest template by EOD UTC. :thumbsup:

rma_manager: once we have manifest template i'll schedule depot pickup. please note: depot will only release units with signed 3-party manifest (vendor, redwood logistics, depot).

aditya: perfect. thanks everyone. i'll wait for the formal quote and manifest. tagging @nex_anna again — can you also confirm insurance coverage (carrier liability vs vendor warranty) in the quote? we want clarity on damage-in-transit vs DOA warranty.

nex_anna: will include insurance split in quote: carrier liability for transit, vendor warranty covers DOA/defects. We'll propose an expedited insurance add-on if you want higher coverage during transit.

marta: we'll aim to sign manifest by 2025-04-08 if quote matches terms. thanks. :white_check_mark:
